body.p: A small fox and a jay met. They started to live together. The fox said: "Let's go, let's kill people, while I go downstream, you sleep." It went upstream. The fox saw people, it woke the jay. They landed, they started stalking, two tents are there. "Shoot at the lower [tent], they will falsely say: "Daddy", and they will say: "Don't shoot", and you shoot." They killed all. The fox shot at the middle pole. The jay saw [it], it started to cry, on the top of the pole it cried, until it became small. When the river was just freezing, [DCh]: Is the jay sitting on the middle pole? What becomes small?the jay ran to the river. The fox saw it and said: "Why are you scraping there with your claws?" "Let's jump", the jay said. The fox jumped and sunk. It went deeply inside the river, it met fish. The fish's mother is sick. The fox said: "I am a shaman, build a pillar upwards." They did. The fox climbed it up and ran home.
